session_token.description: A token used in place of a password for all REST API calls for this user - it is only valid for the IP the login was called from

inactivity_expiration_minutes.description: How long this token will remain active if not used.  It will last for at least this long.

last_login_on.description: Last time the user logged in

last_login_ip_address.description: Last IP the user logged in from

type.description: User's type, i.e. user authenticated local or remotely via SAML

time_zone.description: The time zone setting for this user
